text:
Celia M: Starlight pilot kickoff prep - they need streaming + function/tool calls that produce strict JSON (validated server-side), EU data residency, and customer-managed KMS. Commercial asked for an anchor for ~20 concurrent streams at ~3k tokens/req with spikes to 40.

Jonas (SE): Quick integration note: our websocket/gRPC stream emits delta events. Default SDK waits for function_call.complete, but you can enable incremental delivery with options.partial_tool_payload=true. Small Node example below.

Jonas (SE): ```js
// stream: partial tool args
ws.send(JSON.stringify({type:'start', model:'redwood-stream-1', options:{partial_tool_payload:true}}));
ws.on('message', m => console.log('delta', m.toString()));
```

Jonas (SE): If Starlight wants to act on partial args, they should validate fragments progressively with JSON schema. We also surface a helper in the SDK to reassemble & validate partials.

Priya V: Security draft for questionnaire: "For Dedicated/Private deployments, inference payloads and telemetry remain in the customer's selected region/VPC. We support CMK via major cloud KMS providers and on-prem HSMs. SOC2/ISO artifacts available under NDA. Retention and telemetry controls are configurable." Will confirm exact EU region wording with infra.

Marco (Pricing): Streaming doesn't change token billing. For a Dedicated POC (1 month) we can propose reserved capacity + pilot credit. Rough starting guidance for sizing: conservative reserve = 3 GPU-equivalents for steady 20 concurrent 3k-token contexts + autoscale/burst pool to handle spikes to 40. Recommend a short load test to validate.

Celia M: Can someone run a 20x3k quick test to get a real GPU-hours estimate? We need a procurement anchor by EOD.

Jonas (SE): I'll spin up a mini harness and run a 30-min steady test + a short spike. Expect results in 4 hours. Note: partial_tool_payload increases client CPU but gives earlier partials (first partial often 40-200ms).

InfraBot: Runbook created: runbook://starlight-poc-1805556666 (access: sales,se,security,infra).

Marco (Pricing): Draft commercial anchor: "30% one-time pilot credit on first month of Dedicated reserved capacity (up to N GPU-hours); overage billed at list. Pilot credit subject to legal sign-off." I'll confirm numbers after the load run.

Priya V: Action items: (1) Jonas post test results + Node/Go snippets, (2) Priya finalize questionnaire text + SOC2 link, (3) Marco finalize pilot anchor with GPU-hours, (4) Celia book kickoff (30m) with Starlight for Tue 10am CET.

Celia M: I'll send invite and add this thread to the kickoff packet. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
